# OpenEXR compatibility fixtures

These files come from the Academy Software Foundation's
[`openexr-images`](https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openexr-images)
repository and retain its BSD-3-Clause license and per-directory provenance
notes. They exercise formats that previously failed or were not covered by
Plenoview's generated fixtures.
